assumptions.statement: Provisional boundary used for all spatial calculations. Official SITE_BOUNDARY polygon not yet available in public site package.
assumptions.impact: Area calculations, land use partitioning, and road network design are based on provisional geometry. Must be recalculated when official boundary is released.

assumptions.statement: L3-L4 autonomous vehicle network assumes 85% of current road capacity can be converted to autonomous-only lanes after removing private cars.
assumptions.impact: This is a conceptual design proposal, not a confirmed engineering plan. Requires traffic impact assessment, infrastructure evaluation, and policy approval.

assumptions.statement: FAR, building height, road redlines, and regulatory controls not available in public site package.
assumptions.impact: Building scale and density cannot be finalized without official regulatory plan conditions.

assumptions.statement: Road reconstruction for autonomous vehicle infrastructure requires geotechnical, utility, and traffic engineering studies.
assumptions.impact: Construction feasibility and cost estimates require professional engineering analysis.
